# Low Poly Hand attribution

["Low Poly Hand - 3D Model"](https://skfb.ly/prZXT) by ronildo.facanha is licensed under the [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

The original Blender mesh was scaled, mirrored, fitted to the Unity XR Hands joint hierarchy, skin-weighted, and exported as left- and right-hand FBX assets for Primordia.
